dag.description: Incremental PyTorch pipeline that auto-labels a fresh delta partition via slipbox-routed Bedrock scoring (persisted to EDX), merges it with a stable labeled baseline, rebalances classes with StratifiedSampling, trains PyTorch, then runs inference-based percentile calibration before packaging and registration.

agent_context.when_to_use: Incremental retraining of a PyTorch abuse/risk model where a fresh, unlabeled delta partition must be auto-labeled by an LLM before it joins a stable labeled baseline. The delta rows are routed through slipbox knowledge retrieval, scored by Bedrock, persisted to EDX for reuse, and merged with the baseline; StratifiedSampling then rebalances the combined training set before PyTorch training, and inference-based percentile calibration produces deployment scores. Used by rnr_pytorch_bedrock (dag_incremental).
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If your training data is already fully labeled (no LLM auto-labeling needed) use pytorch_stratified_percentile_e2e. If you do not need class rebalancing use bedrock_slipbox_routing_pytorch_incremental. If the delta should be scored with Bedrock batch inference rather than real-time use bedrock_slipbox_routing_batch_pytorch_incremental. Not for tabular-only models (use an XGBoost DAG).
differentiators: Only pattern combining slipbox-routed Bedrock incremental labeling (delta path) with StratifiedSampling class rebalancing before PyTorch training
Delta partition fans out to BOTH EdxUploading_scored (label persistence) and TabularPreprocessing_training (merge with baseline)
Uses PyTorchModelInference_calibration feeding PercentileModelCalibration, not PyTorchModelEval
Two Cradle sources: CradleDataLoading_baseline (stable labeled) + CradleDataLoading_delta (fresh unlabeled)

prerequisites.check: Bedrock model access for delta scoring
prerequisites.how: Bedrock inference profile provisioned in the pipeline account
SlipboxKnowledgeRouting step configured with a retrieval index

common_pitfalls: BedrockProcessing_delta must complete before TabularPreprocessing_training so freshly scored delta labels are merged with the baseline
StratifiedSampling sits AFTER the baseline+delta merge (between TabularPreprocessing_training and PyTorchTraining), not on the delta path
Calibration path uses inference (not eval); ensure the calibration Cradle source is labeled so percentile buckets can be fit
